titles.title: Spring Tree No. II

description: A wispy tree with a brown trunk and swirling green and gray limbs creates a spiral at the center of the composition. The soft shading throughout the work makes the tree appear as though in a grayish-green haze. The tree stands on tilted, red and brown earth. Patches of blue sky and thin white clouds appear through the gaps in the tree's foliage.
title: Spring Tree No. II
